title: git.md: an M with an empty diff is a line-ending phantom - clear it, do not pass it on
description: InputController.js sat ' M' across many sessions with an empty diff; each agent called it not theirs. It was a stale index size from a CRLF period. Fabio asked (2026-10-05) for one line in .claude/rules/git.md so the next session clears it with git add.
